goal: Allow fee and mempool RPCs to optionally return feerates in sat/vB rather than BTC/kvB.
Eliminates manual unit conversion and precision loss in sub-1 sat/vB conditions for downstream tools.
agreement: Strong support with multiple substantive ACKs and no open technical objections.
Support for backwards-compatible sat/vB reporting across fee RPCs (musaHaruna, willcl-ark)
Concept approval without stated reasons (jonatack, w0xlt)
Minor open request to update the PR description if it is no longer a PoC (willcl-ark)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it adds an optional sat/vB format to fee and mempool RPCs based on user request.
Saves client software from converting units and avoids precision issues in sub-1 sat/vB environments.
